evidence.title: Flutter - Build apps for any screen

name: Flutter
summary: Open-source framework for building natively compiled mobile, web, desktop and embedded apps from one Dart codebase.
description: Flutter is an open-source, multi-platform UI framework from Google that compiles one Dart codebase to mobile, web, desktop and embedded targets, with hot reload and a widget catalog (Material and Cupertino design packages). The site offers downloads, documentation and release news, plus a showcase of production apps including Google Pay, BMW and eBay.
contains: single Dart codebase targeting mobile, web, desktop and embedded
widget catalog with Material and Cupertino design packages
production app showcase: Google Pay, BMW, eBay, Toyota, SoFi and more
packages on pub.dev and Google integrations
